metadata.priority_definition: Existing Trend watchlist + all ETF_BONDS + EQ_MEGA + ETH/USD; fixed before results
metadata.ranking: Median per-instrument CAGR in common post-warmup window; fixed universe with at least 2 calendar years in that window; exhausted accounts receive -100% for ranking only; fewer than 5 closed trades flagged, never excluded
metadata.common_window: Returns from bar index 211 through last bar; same dates across candidates per instrument, existing positions retained, periods differ across instruments
metadata.direction_views: Long-only and short-only are independent runs; combined contributions filter the both-directions run
metadata.evaluation: In-sample exploration, no held-out claim or automatic production selection; native warmup preserved
metadata.chart_sampling: Every fifth observation plus first/last; metrics use every daily observation; raw trade ledgers retain full precision
metadata.costs: Configured assumptions; execution venue, fee tier and short financing not specified
